status: REJECT current short off-axis guide for a confidence print; revise before integrated test
assumptions: Rigid rectangular guide with Coulomb sliding at X/Y walls; reactions separated by available stem overlap.
Ideal freely rolling follower, no cam sliding friction; real bush drag can add load.
Band force2N vertical at X30.6,Y18.6; roller resultant applied at X38,Y27.6.
Guide does not deform; corner pressure, pin compliance and PLA creep excluded.
Friction values are parameter sweeps, not measured PLA coefficients. Failure of this simplified screen is not a prediction of a unique real jam load.
Guide friction-force moments about transverse face offsets are omitted; the binding threshold is an engineering screen, not an exact contact solution.
previous_friction_screen: The old 1/(1-1.8*mu) expression omitted the roller overhang and rear offset, and the off-axis return band. It is not a valid qualification of this guide.
